title: Enhancements for Developing a Comprehensive AI Fairness Assessment Standard
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes extending a fairness assessment standard to include detection of discrimination based on various attributes, including religion, in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, it does not detail a specific benchmark or present results from one.
findings: The paper identifies religion as a potential basis for discrimination in AI systems and Large Language Models, alongside other attributes like race and gender. It argues for the necessity of including fairness assessments for religion in comprehensive standards, but does not provide specific findings or data on religious bias from any model tests.
